referenceBoundary: Original dimensional design assumptions inspired by common modern Japanese rectangular balcony planters and home tomato cultivation; not a claim about a specific 2000-era product.

construction.planter: tapered injection-molded polypropylene proxy with physically closed wall/bottom shell and thick rim
construction.soil: contained dry potting-soil volume with non-flat top
construction.support: three bamboo stakes with modeled nodes, two jute cross ties, and short stem ties
construction.plant: two tomato vines with main stems, compound serrated leaflet shells, rachises, flowers, pedicels/calyx, and green/turning/ripe fruit

weathering: No arbitrary dirt decals or baked highlights. Soil is dry-matte; bamboo/node/jute roughness is material-specific. Engine wetness, UV aging, subsurface/transmission and calibrated Fresnel response remain Unity-unverified.
geometryMaterialSplit: Silhouette, planter wall thickness/rim, soil volume, bamboo/twine supports, stems, leaflets, fruit, flowers and calyx are geometry. Color and surface roughness are material properties; no painted highlight is used.
